title: BPP failure envelope (DESIGN.md §14.2, §14.9; family-vectors/PROFILE.md §3, normative): outcome "problem" plus RFC 9457 problem details
description: problem carries the RFC 9457 members the ratified family profile requires — type, title, and the Byom kind from the closed §14.9 enum (unknown kinds fail closed; new kinds are a spec revision). type is exactly https://byom.dev/problems/<kind> (profile-pinned decision 3; control of the byom.dev problems namespace is an open fact recorded in spec/README.md). status, when present, is a JSON integer in 400-599. RFC 9457 extension members are allowed and carry no authority, but solely under reverse-domain member names (at least three dot-separated lowercase segments) so extensions can never collide with future standard members — aligned to the profile under R0/BYOM-02. Problems never disclose hidden object, participant, peer, path, policy, or membership existence.

problem.$comment: type must equal exactly https://byom.dev/problems/<kind> for the sibling kind member (PROFILE.md §3). JSON Schema cannot cross-reference two members, so the pattern pins the prefix and the snake_case kind shape here, and conformance/run.py enforces exact type/kind agreement as a convention check.

type.description: RFC 9457 type URI: exactly https://byom.dev/problems/<kind>; never about:blank, never another namespace (non-substitutable with kovee's urn:kovee:error:<kind>, PROFILE.md §3.1).

status.description: Optional; when present a JSON integer in 400-599 (never a bool or string).

problem.description: RFC 9457 problem object per the family profile: required type/title/kind; extension members allowed under reverse-domain names only (propertyNames pattern), carrying no authority.

problemKind.description: Stable problem kinds (§14.9), closed for this bundle.
